name: chitchat
description: ChitChat V2 — accessible, secure, private real-time messaging

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @chitchat/design-tokens && npm run build -w @chitchat/contracts && npm run build -w @chitchat/api-client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @chitchat/web && npm run build -w @chitchat/api && npm run build -w @chitchat/mobile
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @chitchat/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @chitchat/api
